item.title: Harris Man Arrested By Troopers
item.description: A Harris, MO man was arrested by State Troopers in Sullivan County Tuesday evening. Sixty-nine-year-old Billy G. Fordyce was arrested at about 7:04 pm for alleged DWI – habitual offender. He was processed and released.

item.title: State Releases The September Jobs Report
item.description: The State’s Jobs report for September was released today (Wednesday), three months late due to the Federal Government shutdown. The September report shows non-farm payroll increased by 18,300 jobs, private industry employment increased by 4,400 jobs, and government employment increased by 13,900 jobs. Missouri’s smoothed seasonally adjusted unemployment rate remains steady at 4.1 percent. That […]

item.title: Election Filing – School Board
item.description: One new filing for the April municipal election has been reported. For the Chillicothe R-II School Board, current board member David Neal filed for re-election. Filing remains open through December 30th.
